source_request: 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently invent a complex, random-feeling but photographically coherent Lunarpunk scene whose lunar, regenerative-ecology, and bioluminescent cues can later be judged in rendered pixels, while using the supplied portrait only to guide the adult subject's visible appearance.
subject: An unmistakably adult woman whose visible facial appearance and long, voluminous, wavy near-black hair are guided by the supplied portrait solely as an appearance reference.
setting: A floating lunar-tide ecology observatory in a misty night marsh, built from living reeds, mycelium, handblown glass, mossy ceramics, and silver dew collectors.
event: The adult ecologist pours luminous algae culture into a crescent-shaped bioreactor, visibly activating pearlescent mycelium conduits throughout the wetland station.
visual_priorities: An unmistakably lunar nocturnal ecology expressed through a visible crescent moon, moon-phase instruments, and cool reflected light
A legible cause-and-effect action linking the algae transfer, crescent bioreactor, and newly glowing mycelium network
Functional integration of thriving wetland life with handcrafted glass, ceramic, fiber, and living technological systems
Natural photographic treatment of the adult subject's portrait-guided visible appearance
baseline_prompt_en: A high-detail Lunarpunk editorial night photograph of an unmistakably adult woman, her facial appearance and long wavy dark hair guided only by the supplied portrait, working as a lunar-tide ecologist at a floating wetland observatory. Beneath a huge visible crescent moon, she pours glowing blue-green algae culture from a handblown glass vessel into a crescent-shaped translucent bioreactor; the transfer visibly ignites pearlescent mycelium conduits woven through reeds and lily pools. She wears an indigo grown-fiber utility coat embroidered with lunar-phase arcs, seed capsules, and shell-fastened tools. Silver dew collectors, moon-phase gauges, moss-covered ceramic instruments, and living vine pipes make the station feel handcrafted yet advanced. The surrounding marsh is dark, misty, and thriving, lit by cool moonlight, bioluminescent fungi, and reflected violet-blue water. Photorealistic skin, tactile natural materials, credible working ecology, subtle grain, complex environmental storytelling.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: Create one independently conceived complex photographic scenario, prepare observable pixel tests, use the attached image for the subject's visible appearance, and leave generation and rendered-pixel judgment for the later phases.

The independently selected Lunarpunk concept is moon-oriented regenerative ecofuturism: nocturnal cycles, wetland stewardship, biological illumination, and handcrafted living technology form one functional scene rather than decorative genre styling.

Use the supplied portrait only as an appearance reference for an unmistakably adult subject; it does not define identity, personality, action, or story, and it does not authorize biometric identity evaluation.
